actions.name: send_mail
actions.title: Send email
actions.help: Send an email to specified recipient from the email address mailer@trial.workato.com. NOTE : The total email size, including attachments, should be less than 20 MB .

input.name: to
input.label: To
input.hint: Provide the recipient email address(es) separated by comma.

input.name: email_type
input.label: Email type
input.hint: Select the format of the email message. Defaults to HTML .

input.name: body
input.label: Message
input.hint: Plain text if selected email type is Text , HTML formatted if selected email type is HTML .

input.name: attachments
input.label: Attachments

properties.name: file_binary_content
properties.label: Binary file content
properties.hint: If 'File binary content' is provided, 'File name' is required.

properties.name: file_name
properties.label: File name
properties.hint: Ex: sample.pdf. Required when File binary content is provided.

input.hint: The total email size, including attachments, should be less than 20 MB . Note that upon upload, the attachment(s) size might be slightly higher and could exceed the size limit.
